## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. Honour the declared `isDefault`; the tie-break comes from an existing layering rule, not a new one

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T08:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** a declared key is inert, so record-page precedence rests on plugin init order. Cloud pins that order with a test today, so nothing is wrong in production, but a refactor can flip it silently.
- **Direction:**
  - `usePageAssignment` prefers `isDefault` record pages. ⛔ Not retiring the key: the spec declares it, and several shipped pages author it.
  - **Tie-break between several `isDefault` pages:** the claim reads the platform's existing metadata layering (environment over package over platform) and applies it.
  - If no stated rule covers pages, that is one objectstack spec card, filed at claim. ⛔ The renderer does not invent precedence.
- **Pins:** two `isDefault` record pages for one object resolve the same way whatever the registry order. CONTROL: a single default is unchanged.
- `Clause-②: no`.

Claim: PM loop round 7 (as triage `6120187277` directs: `usePageAssignment` honours the declared `isDefault`, and the tie-break between several defaults comes from the platform's existing layering, ⛔ not a rule the renderer invents)
Session: `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`
Account: `os-steve`
Branch: `claude/issue-12195-record-page-isdefault`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12195`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface, on objectui `main` `b231607`:
- **The pick:** `packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts`. It returns `candidates[0]` in `meta.pages` order, and its own comment records that `isDefault` is not consulted ("Reading it would be new behaviour, not a repair").
- **The existing layering rule, a candidate to measure:** ADR-0048 Phase 2's prefer-local resolution, which prefers the item owned by the current app's package (`packages/app-shell/src/utils/preferLocal.ts`, used by the console for same-name pages). Also any environment-over-package-over-platform mark the served page items already carry.
- **The call site:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (`usePageAssignment(objectName)`), only if the current app's package must reach the hook. `PageAssignmentOptions` already declares an `app` option, "reserved for future use".
- Co-located tests, and `.changeset/12195-record-page-isdefault.md` (`@object-ui/react` `patch`, plus `@object-ui/app-shell` only if the call site changes).
- ⛔ No new option on `PageAssignmentOptions`, and no other published type change: if one is needed, stop and report. ⛔ If no existing rule decides between two defaults, the renderer invents none: stop and report, and the seat files the objectstack spec card triage named.
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui's record-page assignment (@object-ui/react usePageAssignment), which ignores the declared PageSchema.isDefault and returns the first matching page in GET /meta/page order, so with two default record pages for one object, plugin init order decides | the spec declares isDefault and several shipped pages author it (platform-objects sys-organization/sys-user/sys-position, cloud service-tenant sys-environment/sys-organization); ADR-0048 Phase 2 already prefers the current app's package for same-name metadata | every record page for an object that more than one package ships a default page for; today the Cloud organization page, held only by a cloud test that pins the init order`
Thread-read: 6120187277
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T09:45Z on objectui `main` `b231607`:
- **Duplicates:** no remote branch or open PR touches this card's subject. objectui#7298 and objectui#9674 are closed.
- **This seat's in-flight work** is objectui#12187 item 2 (`PageView.tsx`, `vite.config.ts`) and PRs objectui#12216, #12218 and #12219 in the queue. None touches `usePageAssignment` or `RecordDetailView.tsx`.
- **Seat 2's claims** objectui#12190, #12194 and #12201 touch the environment toolbar, `ManagedByBadge` and the top bar. objectui#12194 renders inside the record page: read its PR before touching `RecordDetailView.tsx`.

Blocked, at 2026-10-12T09:59Z: the dev's measurement (`6121900317`) found no stated rule that decides between two `isDefault: true` record pages for one object. Triage's grade (`6120187277`) covers this case: "If no stated rule covers pages, that is one objectstack spec card, filed at claim. ⛔ The renderer does not invent precedence." That card is now filed.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23015

- **What the measurement found:**
  - ADR-0048 prefer-local is written for bare names only. Even widened, it would not decide the cloud case, because Setup owns neither organization page.
  - `_provenance` decides an overlay against the artifact of the same `(type, name)`, and both cloud pages are `package`.
  - No served mark separates the platform's pages from an app package's.
  - The card carries the dev's options A, B and C and its recommendation, A (one default per object per deployment, a second refused at registration). It is recorded as the dev's recommendation. The seat does not decide it: that is the spec lane's call, or the maintainer's if A's cost (package override of a platform page) is a product call.
- **The seat holds step 1 (sequencing, the seat's call).** Honouring `isDefault` alone ("defaults first, registry order between them") would invert three objectui#7298 pins and break the one override path apps have today, declaration order. It still could not meet triage's pin that two defaults "resolve the same way whatever the registry order". So nothing ships until the rule exists, and the renderer half then lands with it in one PR.
- **The branch:** `claude/issue-12195-record-page-isdefault` sits at `main` `b231607`, with no commits and no PR.

**State:** `pm:blocked`, still assigned to this seat. When objectstack-ai/objectstack#23015 rules and objectui's `@objectstack/spec` floor carries whatever it adds, this card moves back to `pm:dispatched` with an amendment naming the rule, and a dev is dispatched. If the ruling adds a key or option the renderer reads, `Clause-②` is re-stated as `yes` then.

## Unlock scan: `pm:blocked` → `pm:on-hold` · the blocker landed, but not in a version objectui installs · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T06:08Z

The blocker objectstack-ai/objectstack#23015 closed `completed` 2026-10-13T10:11Z, landed as `5f37d36ce3` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23206): at most one `isDefault: true` record page per object per deployment.
- **Not installable yet.** `18.0.0-next.0` was published 2026-10-13T08:35Z, before the landing, and that is what objectui resolves today (`packages/app-shell/package.json`: `^18.0.0-next.0`).
- **The rule ships in next.1.** The pending Version PR's spec changelog lists `5f37d36` under `18.0.0-next.1` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23382).
- **So this card waits on a release, not on a card.** It moves to `pm:on-hold` under the cross-repo rule (the fix must be installable by the consumer). The body now starts with the line below.

Restart-when: `npm view @objectstack/spec@next version` names `18.0.0-next.1` or later (it carries objectstack `5f37d36ce3`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#23015, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23206), and objectui resolves it.

Grade and lane are unchanged: p3, `domain:ui`. On restart, the renderer reads `isDefault` with no tie-break, because the platform now refuses a second default.
